topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a folded piece of paper tucked away in the back of a drawer, the kind where you'd expect old receipts or forgotten notes. It was my partner's handwriting, unmistakable, listing off dreams and desires, each point more vivid than the last. There, laid out like a map of uncharted territory, were the things they’ve always wanted to do—travel to distant lands, learn new languages, even skydive. I had no idea these aspirations held such depth. Now, they seem so much more than just items on a list; they’re windows into a world I realize I know less about than I thought.
